content: देशः [दिश्-अच्] .²1 A place or spot in general; देशः को नु जलावसेकशिथिलः <ls>Mk. 3. 12</ls> (often used after words like कपोल, स्कन्ध, अंस, नितम्ब <ab>&c.</ab>, without any meaning; स्कन्धदेशे <ls>Ś. 1. 19</ls> ‘on the shoulder’). .²2 A region, country, province, land, territory; यं देशं श्रयते तमेव कुरुते बाहुप्रतापार्जितम् <ls>H. 1. 150</ls>. .²3 A department, part, side, portion (as of a whole); as in एकदेश, एकदेशीय <ab>q. v.</ab> .²4 An institute, an ordinance. .²5 Range, compass; दृष्टिदेशः <ls>Pt. 2</ls>.
